title: Golden ruling
description: Torian's ruling on one field of one idea record (docs/reviews/ontology-golden/<idea>.<field>.json). Only Torian's rulings are golden records; a model, an agent or a checker never writes one. The value has the shape the idea record's field takes in packages/naive/src/records/founder-idea.schema.json, so a gated label and a ruling compare as equal values. A ruling cites exactly one source of Torian's words: comment, the issue or pull request comment where he gave it, or card, the decision card he tapped in the project thread.

idea.description: The id of an idea in the workspace founder's ideas folder (people/<id>/ideas/)

field.description: The idea field ruled on. relation rules on the idea's whole relations list

value.description: Torian's value, in the shape of that field of the idea record

comment.description: The URL of the GitHub comment that carries the ruling

card.description: The decision card Torian tapped. The platform verifies the tap came from his own client

thread.description: The id of the project thread that holds the card

message.description: The id of the card message

chosen_at.description: When Torian tapped the option, in UTC

ruled.description: The day Torian gave the ruling

status.description: The idea status values; scripts/golden-ruling-test.ts keeps them equal to founder-idea.schema.json

importance.description: The idea importance values; scripts/golden-ruling-test.ts keeps them equal to founder-idea.schema.json

relations.description: Every typed relation the idea has; an empty list rules that it has none
